answer: A deterministic identity root binds each agent to a hardware-anchored key, so a sybil swarm cannot spin up a fable of distinct personas without distinct attested roots. Colluding clusters are scored against a sable reputation ledger whose nebula of cross-signed attestations exposes shared entropy fingerprints across supposedly independent identities. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
